_about: What Claude Code 2.1.283 handed the model for a plugin command, measured 2026-09-28 (docket C67).
A scratch plugin (claude -p --plugin-dir, hooks and tools disabled) whose command bodies are below was invoked
with each argument string typed after the command name; each expanded body was read back from the session
transcript (<command-args> and the text between PROBE-BEGIN and PROBE-END). Nothing here is computed.
One cell is dropped from body and observation alike: PR=[${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}], which a separate,
argument-independent pass fills with the plugin root. Re-measure with scripts/probe-claude-command-substitution.mjs.

p.body:
T0=[$0] T1=[$1] T2=[$2] T9=[$9] T10=[$10] BR=[${1}] AT=[$@] ST=[$*]
A=[$ARGUMENTS] A0=[$ARGUMENTS[0]] A1=[$ARGUMENTS[1]] A7=[$ARGUMENTS[7]] AH=[$ARGUMENTS_HINT]
Q=["$1"] ESC=[\$1] ESCA=[\$ARGUMENTS] W=[$1abc] U=[$1_x] D=[$0.005]
PRB=[$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT]
